{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-nm-x","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"9ae7afaa2ee3976bdf52714032d85dc55c519d0a2d27491d1de733c10f4ebfde","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-nm-class-std:lineage:24","source_registry_sha256":"22599efcb4852b796972acef6eb09f4cfe8d16ca15887f7ea7660c7748b4df92","source_liveness_sha256":"6766993f61347d495f390e08c7d8b1c44de597b6249cdb10686ea7f9f38e1ea3"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Yielding and traffic priority","heading":"C2 — Yielding and traffic priority","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Yielding and traffic priority

FACT_ID: sec06-R01 | anchor: A02
A driver overtaking another vehicle moving in the same direction must yield to that vehicle even when it slows or stops. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec06-R02 | anchor: A02
Yield to an emergency vehicle operating a siren, air horn, or flashing red or blue light. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec06-R03 | anchor: A02
For an emergency vehicle approaching from any direction, pull to the right edge or as close to the right as possible. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec06-R04 | anchor: A02
Follow instructions broadcast through an emergency vehicle’s loudspeaker. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec06-R05 | anchor: A02
If an emergency vehicle approaches while you are inside an intersection, clear the intersection before pulling over. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec06-R06 | anchor: A02
Stop for a stopped school bus displaying flashing red lights whether it is beside your direction, opposite your direction or at the intersection you approach, except for the divided-road exception. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec06-R07 | anchor: A02
You need not stop for an oncoming school bus when a median or other physical barrier separates the two directions of travel. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec06-R08 | anchor: A02
After school-bus red lights stop flashing, remain stopped until children are completely off the roadway and proceeding is safe. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec06-R09 | anchor: A02
Yield to a train crossing the roadway. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec06-R10 | anchor: A02
If the state makes a public road one-way, it must post signs identifying that direction. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec06-R11 | anchor: A02
On a signed one-way road, drive only in the indicated direction. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec06-R12 | anchor: A02
When circulating around a traffic island, keep to the island’s right side. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0015]
